question: Three numbers are in the ratio of 1 ∶ 4 ∶ 2. Their average is 14. Find the largest number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total sum of the three numbers = Average × 3 = 14 × 3 = 42

Ratio of the numbers = 1 : 4 : 2

Total ratio parts = 1 + 4 + 2 = 7 parts

The largest number corresponds to the largest ratio part (4).

Largest number = (4 ÷ 7) × 42 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**
